name: homebridge-snapshot-sensors
description: Homebridge plugin that retrieves camera snapshots and runs on-device YOLO object detection

scripts.build: npm run clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const f=process.platform==='linux'?'native/yolo-runner/bin/snapshot-sensors-yolo':process.platform==='win32'?'native/yolo-runner/bin/win32-x64/snapshot-sensors-yolo.exe':path.join('native','yolo-runner','bin',process.platform+'-'+process.arch,'snapshot-sensors-yolo');const path=require('path');if(!fs.existsSync(f)||!fs.statSync(f).isFile())throw new Error('Prebuilt YOLO runner is missing: '+f);" && tsc
scripts.build:all: npm run clean && node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const platforms=[['linux-x64','snapshot-sensors-yolo','libonnxruntime.so'],['darwin-x64','snapshot-sensors-yolo','libonnxruntime.dylib'],['darwin-arm64','snapshot-sensors-yolo','libonnxruntime.dylib'],['win32-x64','snapshot-sensors-yolo.exe','onnxruntime.dll']];for(const [platform,bin,ort] of platforms){const dir=path.join('native','yolo-runner','bin',platform);for(const file of [bin,ort]){const p=path.join(dir,file);if(!fs.existsSync(p))throw new Error('Prebuilt YOLO component is missing: '+p);if(!fs.statSync(p).isFile())throw new Error('Prebuilt YOLO component is not a file: '+p);}}" && tsc
